result.description:
Sheet Metal Worker
Employer Sponsorship Available | Perth, WA | Full-Time
MYAC Resources is currently seeking experienced Sheet Metal Workers to join our growing network of leading Australian employers across Perth, Western Australia.
We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality workmanship and want to build a secure, rewarding career with established Australian businesses. Whether you're already in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates. If you're motivated, reliable and passionate about fabrication, we'd love to hear from you.
About the Role
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication 
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
• Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment 
• Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills 
• High attention to detail with pride in producing quality workmanship 
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills 
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards 

Highly Regarded
While not essential, the following experience will be highly regarded:
• MIG and TIG welding experience 
• Stainless steel and aluminium fabrication experience 
• Experience working in manufacturing, mining or heavy industrial environments 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane experience 
• Current Australian Driver's Licence 
• Experience with precision fabrication and custom metalwork 

Employer Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine long-term employment opportunities across Australia for suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship is available, subject to employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
Whether you're already in Australia or planning to relocate, we can help connect you with employers seeking skilled Sheet Metal Workers.

What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time position 
• Perth, Western Australia location 
• Competitive salary package with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career stability with established Australian employers 
• Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment 
• Ongoing training and career development 
• Supportive, safety-focused team environment 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
• Opportunity to build a long-term career in Australia 

Why Join MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia's manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors. We don't just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our experienced recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed. If you're a skilled tradesperson who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to work with reputable Australian employers, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.

If you're an experienced Sheetmetal worker looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au
Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in touch
